generatedFrom: BSC Scores.xlsx (Sheet1: Section/Industry/Team/Rd1/Rd2/.../Recap/Cumulative Total) + Competition Round 2 parsed JSONs (high_level financials + market_share.Total)

priorRound.rankingMetricLabel: Cumulative as of Round 1 (Rd 1 + Practice Recap)
priorRound.note: prevCumulative uses the current Recap column from BSC Scores.xlsx plus Rd1 (Recap values may have been revised since Round 1 was published).

methodNotes.cumulativeTotal: Official score from BSC Scores.xlsx Cumulative Total (text like '227.1 / 1000'). Equals Rd1 + Rd2 + Practice Recap. Ranking is by this number.
methodNotes.roundOnlyBsc: Rd1 and Rd2 columns are that round's Balanced Scorecard only (not running totals). Field bsc mirrors rd2Bsc for compatibility with older site code.
methodNotes.practiceRecap: Recap is the Practice Round Recap score from BSC Scores.xlsx. It is included in the cumulative total.
methodNotes.prevCumulative: Estimated cumulative at end of Round 1 as Rd1 + Recap, using the current Recap value in the spreadsheet (assumption: Recap is stable or the latest official value should be used retrospectively).
methodNotes.rankChange: prevRank − rank on the cumulative leaderboard (positive means the team moved up).
methodNotes.rd2RankChange: rd1Rank − rd2Rank using round-only BSC ranks (positive means the team moved up on Round 2 performance alone).
methodNotes.tieBreak: Cumulative rank ties: higher rd2Bsc, then team name A–Z. prevCumulative ties: higher rd1Bsc, then team name. Round-only ranks: higher score, then team name (rd2 also uses rd1Bsc as secondary).
methodNotes.maxPoints: cumulativeMax is 1000 when the Cumulative Total cell is written as 'X / 1000'.

bscNote: Official ranking uses Cumulative Total (Rd1+Rd2+Recap). Rd1/Rd2 columns remain per-round scores.
membersNote: Team members are first and last display names only. No emails, usernames, or student IDs.
